fundamentals.name: Astera Labs, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Astera Labs, Inc. designs, manufactures, and sells semiconductor-based connectivity solutions for cloud and AI infrastructure in Taiwan and the United States. It offers an intelligent connectivity platform, comprised of semiconductor-based, high-speed, mixed-signal connectivity products that integrate a matrix of microcontrollers and sensors, and COSMOS. The company provides COSMOS software suite, a connectivity system management and optimization software that enables management and optimization of resources for large fleets at cloud-scale via link, fleet, and RAS management capabilities. In addition, it offers PCIe/CXL smart DSP retimers and cable modules; ethernet smart cable modules for cloud and AI infrastructure; CXL memory connectivity controllers; and smart fabric switches. The company serves hyperscalers and system original equipment manufacturers. Astera Labs, Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is based in San Jose, California.

judgment.summary: High-growth, highly profitable company with a strong balance sheet, albeit trading at a premium valuation.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat EPS estimates by 13.5%; next earnings date is 2026-08-04.
positives: Revenue growth 93.4% YoY and earnings growth 144.4% YoY indicate strong business momentum.
Gross margin of 76.0% and profit margin of 26.7% demonstrate excellent profitability.
Return on equity of 21.1% and return on assets of 10.1% show efficient capital utilization.
Strong liquidity with a current ratio of 11.30 and quick ratio of 10.55, supported by $1.18B cash.
Analyst consensus is 'buy' with a strong growth estimate for the current fiscal year.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 240.75 and forward P/E of 85.27 indicate a very high valuation.
Price/Sales (TTM) of 61.40 and Price/Book of 41.13 also suggest the stock is richly valued.
Debt/Equity ratio of 2.80, while manageable with strong cash flow, is notable.
Beta of 3.36 signifies significantly higher volatility than the broader market.
Analyst mean target of $244.97 is substantially below the current spot price.

news.paragraph: Astera Labs has seen significant stock appreciation, soaring over 200% in three months and up 70% since its last earnings report, driven by strong revenue and earnings growth. Analysts are positive, with Barclays raising its price target citing a product portfolio ramp-up. The company's robust growth and high margins are key factors, though its premium valuation and beta of 3.36 suggest high volatility.
